objective: Determine whether the public article page exposes machine-readable 35 MPa and 70 MPa dispenser/vehicle refueling traces suitable for an auxiliary station-side comparison.

source.title: Study on comprehensive evaluation of 35 MPa/70 MPa hydrogen dispenser refueling performance

allowed_operations: inspect publisher-linked CSV or figure ZIP metadata
read schema, units, channel labels and rights/citation metadata
run descriptive or post-publication diagnostic comparisons
prohibited_claims: promotion of a parameter fitted to this article
universal dispenser or vehicle safety claim
full station-to-vehicle validation unless all channels and provenance satisfy a new frozen protocol
eligibility_rule: The route may become an auxiliary data-quality or descriptive benchmark only. It cannot close an existing primary external-validation gate because article outcomes were visible before this route was frozen.
stage2_requirements: publisher-linked file resolves and checksum is recorded
channel identity, engineering units, time base and tank geometry are explicit
license or publisher reuse terms are recorded
no post-access fitting is promoted to runtime
claim_boundary: This protocol separates source discovery from scientific validation. A successful download does not by itself establish full-loop accuracy, field safety, regulatory compliance or SAGA effectiveness.
